surface: Showcase List Pattern picker cancellation after changing a configured draft scope
reproduction: On a repeated-card page, configure collection A with a title or URL field and run Extract so a useful preview is visible.
Click Pick more fields, press Restart inside the page overlay, click an element inside a different repeated collection B, and explicitly choose B's scope.
Press Cancel inside the overlay without pressing Done. Inspect the List Pattern editor and prior preview.
expected: Cancel discards the entire in-progress picker transaction. Collection A, its selected fields, and its prior preview remain usable. Explicit Done may commit B even with zero fields so the existing inspector workflow can suggest fields for B.
actual_source_confirmed: Choosing B emits data:list-picker-item-detected immediately. ListPatternTab handles it before Done by invalidating the preview and replacing A plus its fields with B plus an empty field_paths array. Cancel emits only data:list-picker-exit and the sidepanel handler merely closes the session; A and its preview are not restored. This affects the unsaved builder draft, not a previously persisted saved pattern record.
root_cause_source_confirmed: The picker sends an early scope event to populate suggested fields, while the sidepanel treats that provisional event as a committed config replacement. No session-local draft/commit boundary exists between scope selection and Done.
